title: fix(cli): os package install prints the connector maps the package export withheld
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB7J3TmFTYMYQrfpye6GQNg9)_

Fixes #29873

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** `os package install` 在安装成功后读取安装应答里的 `withheldMaps`,逐条打印被导出扣下的连接器映射(`connector 'NAME' PATH`),附一句补救:到连接器的编写处重新填入该映射。托管(热加载与未热加载)和非托管两种模式、目录 id 与制品文件两种来源都打印。
- **为什么改:** 导出包时连接器的 header / env 映射被整张扣下,服务端 install-local 的应答已逐条点名,但 CLI 把这个键丢了。按文档用 `os package install DIR/NN-ID/objectstack.json` 安装的运维看不到任何提示,直到连接器运行时不带 header 才失败。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改 CLI 的输出文字:应答不带该列表(或列表为空)时一行都不多印,退出码不变,服务端与导出不动。命令没有 `--json` 输出。`@objectstack/cli` patch。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts` 顶部的 `printWithheldMaps`,以及两处调用(非托管分支 `Sample data` 之后、托管分支 `Hot-load error` 之后);测试 `packages/cli/test/package-install-withheld-maps.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/package-install-withheld-maps.test.ts`,预期 `12 passed`。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts`.** A module-local `printWithheldMaps(answer.withheldMaps)` prints, when the install-local answer carries a non-empty list:
  ```text
    ⚠ 2 connector map(s) arrived empty — the package export withheld each one whole, so the connector sends none of those headers or environment variables:
      connector 'w5export_erp' providerConfig.headers
      connector 'w5export_mcp' providerConfig.transport.env
    Re-enter each map where the connector is authored.
  ```
  - **Every install mode the command has.** It is called in the unmanaged success branch (after `Sample data`) and in the managed success branch (after `Hot-load error`), which covers a hot-loaded and a not-hot-loaded managed install. Both sources (catalog id, artifact file) reach those same branches.
  - **From the answer only.** An absent or empty list prints nothing. Nothing is read from the artifact the command sent, so a runtime that predates the key gets the output it always got. This matches the `strippedLocks` reader in the same file.
  - **No `--json`.** The command's `flags` block declares no `json` flag and the class sets no `enableJsonFlag`, so there is no machine output to carry the list.
  - **Exit code unchanged.** The connector is installed and runs; the warning changes nothing about success.
- **Not changed.** The server answer (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, both modes already answer `withheldMaps`) and the export (`assemblePackageManifest` already writes it), per the ruling. Neither frozen file (`protocol.ts`, `engine.ts`) is touched.
- **Declarations.** `Clause-②: no`: `printWithheldMaps` is not exported, no flag or exported signature changes, and no input the command accepted is refused. `Metadata-protocol: none`: CLI text only. Changeset `29873-install-prints-withheld-maps.md`: `@objectstack/cli` patch.

## Tests

New `packages/cli/test/package-install-withheld-maps.test.ts` (unit tier, derived by `vitest-tiers.ts`), 12 cases, the stub-`fetch` harness of the sibling `package-install-*.test.ts` files. For each of managed hot-loaded, managed not hot-loaded, and unmanaged (`--install-mode unmanaged`):

- a catalog install whose answer carries two maps prints the warning, one line per map with connector name and path, and the remedy, and exits normally;
- an artifact-file install (an `objectstack.json` shaped like an `os package export` directory, with `withheldMaps`) prints the same for its one map;
- an answer whose `withheldMaps` is absent, or empty, prints none of those lines.

<details><summary>Ablations (both red as expected, both restored to HEAD)</summary>

Run with `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts`; the test imports `../src/...` directly, so no dist leg is involved.

1. **Old behaviour back** (anchor `  if (maps.length === 0) return;` replaced by `  return;`, so nothing is printed): `Tests 6 failed | 6 passed (12)`. The 6 red are the positive pins (`names each withheld map …` and `names the withheld map for an exported artifact file …`, in all three modes). Restored: `blob == HEAD (0e2e99b694e2) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
2. **Negative pin** (the empty-list guard deleted, so an absent or empty list prints `0 connector map(s) arrived empty`): `Tests 6 failed | 6 passed (12)`, all six `prints no withheld-map line when the answer's list is absent|empty`, `AssertionError: … not to contain 'arrived empty'`. Restored the same way.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's step 3 (server answer and `WARN [MarketplaceInstallLocal]` line) is unchanged and was not re-measured on a boot here; the pins stub the answer in the shape `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` returns (`...(withheldMaps.length > 0 ? { withheldMaps } : {})` in both modes).
- The warning goes to stdout with the rest of the command's output, through the existing `printWarning`.

## Verification

All runs at head `d3e4350de` (the last commit; the PR adds no later commit).

- **Build:** `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli^...' build` under `os-verify-lock`: `VERDICT command-exit 0` (5m54s). Then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Test Files 379 passed (379)`, `Tests 5323 passed (5323)`. The integration tier is declared to CI: the diff touches no integration-tier file or spawn entry.
- **Lint:** `pnpm lint`: exit 0. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the two touched `.ts` files: exit 0.
- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 60 families for the 3 changed paths; all 60 run, `--ran` reconciles `58 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, exit 0. The two NOT MEASURED families are `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage`, both exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: they read every package's `dist/`, and this checkout built only the cli closure). CI runs both on a full build. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone; after `git fetch origin 621a4876` it passed (48 cases).
